author: JJTheGuy
body:
Aight fam, so in a few days I'm going on this trip with a ton of classmates and I'm in charge of bringing speakers and I'm resident DJ. Problem is... I don't have a playlist that's lit enough and will keep everyone happy. So... Help me out here. Let's make a lit af playlist.
